title: [CON2-11] `RelayPeerAnnouncement` is a "gossip message" with no topic allowed to carry it
description: Review finding CON2-11: `RelayPeerAnnouncement` is a "gossip message" with no topic allowed to carry it (lens CON2). Location: spec/10-relays.md:256; :282-286, :332; spec/05-messaging.md:395. Fix: §10.2.6 sends it "as a `RelayPeerAnnouncement` gossip message"; §10.3.1 allows only SpaceAds/RelayAds on `v1/agora/discovery` and §10.3.2 says a Relay "MUST NOT forward any record on `v1/agora/discovery` other than a SpaceAd or RelayAd". Carry it over the Peer API (`POST /v1/agora/peer/announce`, 10:153, already exists for peer introduction) to Level 2+ peers, and change the 05:395 row to "relay-to-relay Peer API". Full text: notes/review2/CON2-verified.md and notes/review2/CON2.md.
